messages:
maya (People Ops): Quick sync: we've published a short Confidentiality & Data Handling addendum and a small retroactive correction to parental leave pay timing for people who had leave in 2025. Two manager actions this round: 1) confirm your team has acked the addendum; 2) review any retro pay flags in the Parental Leave Corrections tab. Deadline for confirmations: 2026-07-15. Links: https://go.redwood/hr/confidentiality-addendum and the tracker: https://go.redwood/hr/ack-tracker

evan (People Ops): TL;DR: everyone must read the addendum; only managers need to mark the "Manager Ack" column for their directs. Retro pay flags are pre-populated for affected people; managers should verify and add a short note if they confirm the correction.

jordan (Benefits): Benefits note: retroactive pay adjustments will be processed in the July payroll run if confirmed by managers by the deadline. If you see an incorrect flag or missing documentation, mark "Needs Review" and cc benefits@redwood.com.

rachel (Legal): Legal reviewed the addendum. It includes refreshed examples for handling customer PII, requirements for local NDAs, and an escalation path for suspected mishandling. If your team uses non-standard NDAs, please attach them in the tracker comment field.

priya (EM): Quick Q — do contractors who had parental leave through an MSP vendor get the retro pay?

maya (People Ops): Contractors on payroll through Redwood who had documented parental leave are included. MSP/third-party payroll cases marked in the tracker as "third_party_pay" will be routed to HR Ops separately.

toni (Hiring Ops): Ops note: new offers after 2026-06-01 will include the addendum link in onboarding step 2. Hiring managers, please confirm the onboarding checklist includes the ack for new hires. We'll add an automated flag on offers where confidentiality responsibilities are expected.

ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-07-01T09:00Z — weekly autopulse to employees who haven't clicked the addendum link.

evan (People Ops): Manager deliverables recap: 1) Use the per-manager CSV we dropped to verify your direct reports; 2) Mark the Manager Ack checkbox by 2026-07-15; 3) Confirm any parental leave corrections ("Confirmed" or "Needs Review") and add a 1-line note for audit. Per-manager CSV: `ack_exports/2060102468_manager_csvs.zip`.

priya (EM): Can you give a one-line blurb I can paste into my squad channel? Prefer short.

maya (People Ops): Sure — copy this: `Action: Read the Confidentiality & Data Handling addendum and confirm by Jul 15. Managers: mark confirmations in the shared tracker; review any parental leave retro-pay flags.`

jordan (Benefits): We'll post an FAQ for managers tomorrow covering payroll timing and how to handle third-party payroll cases.

rachel (Legal): One more legal reminder: when you add private NDA attachments in tracker comments, avoid including sensitive contract attachments in-line; instead link to the secure contract repo and note the repo path.

evan (People Ops): Final note: People Ops will run a compliance export the week after the deadline and reach out to managers with >5 outstanding confirmations. If you need a custom CSV slice earlier, DM @evan. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
